$comment: HyperIDE (hypercanvas-preview) telemetry manifest. Enumerates every event the extension may send, for `code --telemetry` transparency. All properties are enums, counts, durations, booleans, or hashes — NEVER source code, file paths, prompts, URLs, or personal data. Telemetry is gated on VS Code's global telemetry setting AND hypercanvas.telemetry.enabled. Backends: PostHog EU (analytics), Sentry EU (errors).

session.activated.properties: activationReason, vscodeVersion, coldStartMs, hasWorkspace, projectType, cssSystem, uiKit

session.heartbeat.comment: Periodic liveness ping. properties: activeMs, focused

session.ended.comment: Session ended. properties: durationMs, commandCount, aiRequestCount, previewRenderCount, errorCount, endReason

funnel.firstPreview.comment: First successful preview render on this machine (once). properties: msSinceActivate, succeeded

command.invoked.comment: A HyperIDE command ran. properties: commandId (enum), durationMs, outcome (ok|error|cancelled)

preview.renderSucceeded.comment: Preview rendered a component successfully. properties: renderMs?, componentKind

preview.renderFailed.comment: Preview failed to render. properties: errorClass (componentError|runtimeError|componentMissing), errorCategory, scrubbedMessageHash

preview.blankDetected.comment: Blank-preview 'process is not defined' detected (dedicated counter).

devServer.failed.comment: Dev server errored. properties: errorCategory, scrubbedMessageHash

ai.requestStarted.comment: AI chat request started. properties: provider (enum), model, feature

ai.requestCompleted.comment: AI chat request finished. properties: durationMs, outcome (ok|error|aborted), errorCategory?

ai.suggestionShown.comment: AI-generated suggestion displayed to the user. properties: feature, provider (enum)

ai.suggestionAccepted.comment: User accepted an AI suggestion. properties: feature, provider (enum), elapsedMs

ai.suggestionRejected.comment: User dismissed/rejected an AI suggestion. properties: feature, provider (enum), elapsedMs

canvas.elementSelected.comment: User selected a canvas element. properties: elementKind, depth?

canvas.elementHovered.comment: User hovered over a canvas element. properties: elementKind

canvas.dragStarted.comment: User started a drag on a canvas element. properties: elementKind

canvas.dragEnded.comment: Drag ended on canvas. properties: moved (bool), elementKind

canvas.elementResized.comment: Canvas element resized by the user. properties: axis (x|y|both), elementKind

canvas.elementInserted.comment: New element inserted on the canvas. properties: elementKind

canvas.elementDeleted.comment: Element deleted from canvas. properties: elementKind

canvas.elementDuplicated.comment: Element duplicated on canvas. properties: elementKind

canvas.elementWrapped.comment: Element wrapped in a container. properties: wrapperKind

canvas.modeSwitched.comment: Canvas switched between component and app mode. properties: mode (component|app)

canvas.routeNavigated.comment: User navigated to a different route in the canvas preview. properties: fromRoute (hash), toRoute (hash)

canvas.previewRefreshed.comment: Preview manually refreshed by the user.

canvas.contextMenuOpened.comment: Context menu opened on a canvas element. properties: elementKind

canvas.contextMenuAction.comment: User invoked an action from the canvas context menu. properties: action (enum)

canvas.zoomed.comment: Canvas zoom level changed. properties: direction (in|out|reset)

explorer.itemOpened.comment: User opened a component/page from the Explorer. properties: itemKind

explorer.treeToggled.comment: Explorer tree node expanded or collapsed. properties: expanded (bool)

explorer.searched.comment: User typed in the Explorer search field. properties: resultCount

explorer.itemCreated.comment: New component/page created from Explorer. properties: itemKind

explorer.itemMoved.comment: Explorer item moved to another location. properties: itemKind

explorer.itemSelected.comment: Explorer item selected (focus/highlight, not open). properties: itemKind

explorer.navigated.comment: Explorer navigated to a folder or page. properties: depth

inspector.elementInspected.comment: An element was loaded into the Inspector panel. properties: elementKind, depth?

inspector.propEdited.comment: User edited a prop value in the Inspector. properties: propKind (enum), valueKind (string|number|boolean|expression|other)

inspector.styleEdited.comment: User edited a CSS/style property in the Inspector. properties: styleProperty (enum), valueKind

inspector.textEdited.comment: User edited text content via the Inspector. properties: elementKind

inspector.tabSwitched.comment: User switched tabs in the Inspector panel. properties: tab (enum)

inspector.toggled.comment: Inspector panel opened or closed. properties: visible (bool)

panel.opened.comment: An extension panel was opened. properties: panel (preview|explorer|inspector|aiChat|logs)

panel.closed.comment: An extension panel was closed. properties: panel (preview|explorer|inspector|aiChat|logs)

theme.changed.comment: VS Code theme changed. properties: kind (light|dark|highContrast|highContrastLight)

error.unhandled.comment: Unhandled host error (ours, not foreign). properties: kind (unhandledRejection|uncaughtException), errorName, scrubbedStackHash, isForeign(false)

error.handled.comment: A handled error. properties: where (enum), errorName, scrubbedMessage, severity

error.webviewCrash.comment: A webview React bundle crashed. properties: context, lastEvent?

feedback.aiThumb.comment: User rated an AI response. properties: responseId, model?, score (1|0), reasonCategory?

dissatisfaction.quickUndo.comment: An accept/apply was undone almost immediately. properties: action, elapsedMs

dissatisfaction.retryLoop.comment: Same action re-invoked repeatedly without success. properties: key, count, windowMs

dissatisfaction.errorThenQuit.comment: An error occurred shortly before the session ended. properties: sinceErrorMs

dissatisfaction.rageClick.comment: Rapid repeated clicks on the same target (webview). properties: target, clickCount, windowMs

dissatisfaction.deadClick.comment: A click with no resulting state change (webview). NOTE: not yet emitted (see useDissatisfactionClicks TODO).

dissatisfaction.errorClick.comment: A click shortly after a runtime error (webview). properties: target, precededError
